caveat: See the warnings block; the single most important caveat is that n=3 is the minimum and that the between-architecture arm was not run.
claim_under_test: The seed variance of D_eff on TRAINED checkpoints is small enough that the paper's stability argument (passage bootstrap <= 3e-4 in S18 plus random-weight seed <= 2e-4 in S10) extends to trained models.
comparability: New cohort. Fixed-iteration budget (not the harness wall clock), char-level shakespeare_char (not climbmix-400b + 8192-BPE), plain pre-norm GPT decoder (not the harness sliding-window / value-embedding / Muon variant). New config_fingerprint and new data_fingerprint, therefore its own baseline, measured in the same batch on the same pod. NOT comparable to any val_bpb autoresearch arm and never pooled with cpu-numpy-frozen-upstream-code-20260928 or cmp:estimator-cpu-v1-fixedtable-transcription.
cost_usd_note: Computed, not metered: total pod wall clock this session was about 55 minutes across three pods at 0.59 USD/h, so 0.54 USD. Runpod's daily billing bucket still reports totalAmount 0 because aggregation lags, so this is an estimate from wall clock, not a read of the bill. Recorded spend on the leaderboard before this batch was 0.00, so this is the whole of AXV-43's cost and it leaves at least 2.71 of the 3.25 company budget.
gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 1g.24gb
provisional_reason: n=3 is the bare minimum for a standard deviation. The between-architecture arm and the fourth seed were dropped by a units bug in the batch's own budget guard, so the between-architecture comparison is made against the paper's published between-model spread rather than a same-cohort arm. See warnings.

series_deviations.architecture: plain pre-norm GPT decoder, the architecture Appendix S17 describes, not the harness sliding-window / value-embedding / Muon variant
series_deviations.corpus: char-level shakespeare_char, the corpus of the paper's own Appendix S17 arm, not the harness default climbmix-400b + 8192-BPE. New data_fingerprint.
series_deviations.fixed_iteration_budget_not_wall_clock: D_eff is a checkpoint property; the paper's anchor for this configuration is stated at 'iter 5000'. A wall-clock budget would move the anchor.
series_deviations.not_comparable_to: any val_bpb autoresearch arm, and never pooled with the CPU cohorts cpu-numpy-frozen-upstream-code-20260928 or cmp:estimator-cpu-v1-fixedtable-transcription

variable_rationale: The paper's two stability floors are both measured on things that are not trained checkpoints: passage resampling (S18) and random-weight initialisation (S10). Seed is the axis the paper never measures, and the one every practitioner use of D_eff depends on.
warnings: NOT VERIFIED, and the reason is named rather than hidden: the between-architecture arm (L=16) and the gamma=0.5 estimator positive control were skipped by the batch's own budget guard, and a fourth seed was skipped. The guard's own log line records the arithmetic: need_sec 793650 against remaining_sec 856. That printed figure was a units bug in the guard - milliseconds multiplied by 1.15 and not divided by 1000 - so the printed number was off by a factor of about 842 and could not be trusted. The corrected arithmetic is 5000 * 138 * 115 / 100000 = 793 plus a 150 second measurement reserve, so need_sec is 943 against 856 remaining and skipping those three arms was the right decision anyway. Fixed in harness commit e9702dd, and the correction to that fix recorded in dc64e08. Three seeds did complete, which meets the three-seed minimum, and the between-architecture comparison is therefore made against the paper's PUBLISHED between-model spread rather than a same-cohort arm. Fixing the guard is queued in the harness.
